final: WITH per_acc AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amt FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS mean_avg FROM per_acc) SELECT p.account_id, p.avg_amt, p.avg_amt - m.mean_avg AS diff_above_mean FROM per_acc p, m WHERE p.avg_amt > m.mean_avg ORDER BY diff_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10
